description:
When to call: before you connect to, install, wire into an agent, or recommend an MCP server, to check what the public record shows about whether it is still maintained. Pass the MCP schema-server id.
Returns: JSON with trust_score (0 to 100 or null), display (score · depth · provisional), depth/depth_max, per-dimension values (liveness, maintenance, adoption, spec_currency, dependency_health; null = unknown, never invented), effective_weights, resolution method/confidence, status (scored | unresolved | insufficient_data), methodology URL. Depth 2 answers mortality more than merit; cite display as-is. Not a prediction, not advice, not a ranking of alternatives.
Example: {"id":"io.github.06ketan/medium-ops"}
id: MCP schema-server identifier (e.g. io.github.owner/name or owner/name). Not an npm package name, Action slug, or Docker image.
name: trust_score
